top_signals.title: Gold Extends Drop on Stronger-Than-Expected US Jobs Print
top_signals.summary: Gold fell after a hot US nonfarm payrolls print, which added fuel to expectations that the Federal Reserve will seek to raise interest rates to contain inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: TeraWulf’s bitcoin mining revenue falls 69% as HPC leasing surges amid Anthropic buildout
top_signals.summary: TeraWulf reported $63 million in artificial intelligence-related quarterly HPC lease revenue, up 774% year over year.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.

top_signals.title: Harden cooling systems now, feds warn critical infrastructure operators amid attacks
top_signals.summary: The U.S. government on Thursday called on critical infrastructure operators to safeguard their cooling systems following hacks that have caused chaos in European supermarkets in recent weeks.

top_signals.title: Anthropic IPO Investors Weigh Valuation as Low as $1.2 Trillion
top_signals.summary: Anthropic PBC’s initial public offering plans ran into a punishing post-election selloff, prompting a rethink among prospective investors of the company’s expected valuation.

top_signals.title: Canada Jobless Rate Rises to 6.7% Amid Small Employment Decline
top_signals.summary: Canada's unemployment rate edged up to 6.7% in October as more people looked for work and employment fell modestly, pointing to ongoing softness in the labor market.
